subject: Vendor onboarding: pre-auth checklist + bank details needed for marketplace listing
body:
From: Lisa Chen <lisa@altavista.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: BillingOps <billing@altavista.io>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace onboarding — pre-auth checklist + bank details for PO route

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the kickoff call this morning. We're excited to move our listing live on the AWS/GCP marketplaces. Procurement asked me to send the set of items they need to complete vendor activation on their side so we can accept marketplace POs and routing.

Short list from our side:
- Master vendor form (filled)
- Vendor banking authorization (bank account + ACH pre-auth)
- Tax docs (W9)
- Marketplace product code and pricing sheet
- Preauth confirmation for invoice routing (email contact for finance)

I've attached our internal instructions and the vendor banking sheet. Can you confirm whether Redwood needs a separate marketplace payee account or if we can attach Altavista's billing to the same vendor profile? Also let us know the preferred PO format from your marketplace integrations team.

Lisa
Lisa Chen
Finance Ops, Altavista AI
Attachment: altavista-preauth-instructions.pdf (3 pages)
Attachment: vendor-banking-authorization-form.xlsx (spreadsheet)

---
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Chen <lisa@altavista.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding — pre-auth checklist + bank details for PO route

Hi Lisa — thanks for sending these. Looping in Vanessa (Marketplace Partnerships) and Kimberly (FinOps integration) to confirm the exact vendor flow.

Quick answers:
- We can support Altavista's single vendor profile for both AWS and GCP listings, but each cloud marketplace will require a unique marketplace payee ID in our system for routing. That's an internal identifier we map to your legal vendor record.
- For PO ingestion, preferred format is a standard PDF PO with an integer PO number; our ingestion supports EDI 850 and email-based PDF receipts. If Procurement wants EDI, we can provide onboarding docs.

Next steps:
1) Vanessa to confirm whether Redwood needs bank verification (micro-deposit) or ACH-letter preauth for marketplace payout mapping.
2) Kimberly to confirm required fields on the banking spreadsheet and whether Redwood accepts CSV import.

I'll QA the attachments and follow up by EOD.

Thanks,
Jonas
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Lisa Chen <lisa@altavista.io>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Marketplace onboarding — pre-auth checklist + bank details for PO route

Thanks Lisa — welcome aboard. Vanessa here. High level from our vendor intake:
- We require a completed vendor banking authorization; we prefer ACH preauth via micro-deposits (2 small deposits). If Altavista prefers to send an ACH authorization letter from the bank, we can accept that instead.
- W9 is required for US vendors before first payout.
- Marketplace payee IDs: we'll create one per cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) and share the payee IDs to include in invoices/POs so routing is automatic.
- For PO ingestion: PDF PO attached via invoice email to marketplace-invoices@redwood.ai (we parse and match to payee ID + PO number). EDI is optional/planned for later.

Action items for Altavista:
- Return completed vendor-banking-authorization-form.xlsx with a signed page and bank contact info.
- Attach signed W9 (PDF).
- Confirm the email for invoice submission and any AP contact names and phone numbers.

Ben — can you confirm our expected time-to-activate once we have the banking form + W9? We typically do a one-business-day manual review plus 1–2 business days for micro-deposits to clear.

Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference

---
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Lisa Chen <lisa@altavista.io>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Marketplace onboarding — pre-auth checklist + bank details for PO route

Confirming standard timing: 1 business day for underwriting review once docs are uploaded to our vendor portal, then 1–3 business days for micro-deposit verification depending on bank. If Altavista provides a formal bank letter signed by an officer, we can expedite and skip micro-deposits (same-day in some cases).

Also note: for AWS Marketplace specifically, there is an extra step — AWS may send a separate payee confirmation email; please forward that to finance@redwood.ai so we can reconcile.

Ben Carter
Senior FinOps Manager
Redwood Inference

---
From: Lisa Chen <lisa@altavista.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding — pre-auth checklist + bank details for PO route

Thanks — attached are the completed forms and a signed W9. We opted to include a bank letter from our treasury team to request expedited verification.

Files attached: vendor-banking-authorization-form.xlsx, W9_altavista_signed.pdf, altavista-preauth-instructions.pdf

A couple of notes from Procurement:
- Their PO numbering will come from AWS/GCP — they asked whether Redwood needs any prefix in the PO number for internal reconciliation.
- AP contact is ap@altavista.io and they prefer invoice PDFs emailed to marketplace-invoices@redwood.ai.

Please confirm receipt and let us know the expected activation window.

Best,
Lisa

---
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Chen <lisa@altavista.io>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Marketplace onboarding — pre-auth checklist + bank details for PO route

Lisa — received everything, thanks. Quick checklist update:
- Vendor record created in portal: payee_us_7421 (AWS), payee_gcp_7421 (GCP). Please reference one of these payee IDs on invoices so we can match automatically.
- Bank verification: bank letter accepted; we processed it and set the vendor status to Active-Pending-Payout. No micro-deposits needed.
- W9 validated and stored.
- PO format: no special prefix required — simply ensure the PO number is included in the PDF body and filename is PO_[number].pdf (this helps our parser).

Expected timeline: first PO from marketplace should route to marketplace-invoices@redwood.ai and reach Altavista's payee mapping within 24 hours. First payout will follow Redwood's next pay cycle (net-30 from invoice match) unless you elect accelerated payout (separate agreement).

I'll attach a short checklist and a sample invoice filename pattern for your team.

—Kimberly Park
FinOps Integration Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachment: sample-invoice-filename-and-checklist.txt
